decisions.reason: The rotating-skip compact dumper sits within the established dumper range and shares parts and service infrastructure, so holding the option is cheap while its market value is still resolving.
The articulated dumper extends the core construction offer at low holding cost, and two years of sparse results do not yet show that its value will fail to materialize.
The multi-model telescopic loader line close to the established business keeps several growth options open, and no negative evidence argues for abandoning it.
The material lift line is already showing value through a large rental order and a strong rental market position, so uncertainty is resolving favourably and further commitment is justified.

Although it is distant from the core offer, like the withdrawn rescue vehicle, the mining loader's 1,000 operating hours in seven months are a positive early signal that justifies keeping the option open while its market value becomes clearer.
